items.reason: Inclusion admits 'glioblastoma or WHO grade 4 astrocytoma (IDH wild type or mutant)', i.e. IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma is explicitly eligible beside glioblastoma; under CNS5 that is a separate glioma type, so several types are eligible with GBM named. D27C (grade 4 astrocytoma without IDH requirement = gbm_only) is the counter-argument, since no IDH status is required.

note: Outcome-neutral: phase NA radiotherapy-technique study, fails S3 (phase_not_applicable) and S6. XL may want one consistent rule for 'grade 4 astrocytoma (IDH wild type or mutant)' (mixed vs gbm_only under D27C); same issue in NCT06017063. Coder A's IDH exploratory row and temozolomide row (priority 3) are not needed: IDH is not required, and TMZ is only an eligibility expectation.
